title: Flaky: VS Code extension E2E (browser-debugger) times out waiting for Blazor page/WASM debug session to become interactive
test_name: Aspire Blazor browser debugger E2E hits a managed breakpoint for standalone
job_name: Tests / Run VS Code extension E2E tests / VS Code extension E2E (Windows, browser-debugger)
error_pattern: Failed to apply E2E control revision 1790042422693: Error: Timed out after 295830ms waiting for pwa-msedge child session for Blazor WASM root 'd31ab16e-918a-4ba6-b8ce-0a5bdfddd7bf'. Last error: <none>. State: {"debugSessions":[{"id":"f95e3721-6a8e-46c4-8211-7ff874d9d5e0","type":"monovsdbg_wasm","name":"Wasm Managed Debugger",...}]}
analysis: This test failure matches a well-known recurring flaky pattern (28 prior occurrences, last seen 2026-09-21) where the Blazor WASM managed debugger E2E test times out waiting for the pwa-msedge child debug session to attach. The PR under test (#20296) only modifies GitHub Actions workflow files and adds new Infrastructure.Tests unit tests for a deployment-test-command harness; it does not touch any VS Code extension debugger, Blazor WASM, or E2E test code, so the failure is unrelated to the PR changes.
